subtasks.objective: Require POST for all state-changing Frappe whitelisted endpoints identified by SEC-14 so browser-navigable GET requests cannot mutate restaurant, invoice, KOT, printing, table, or customer state.
subtasks.acceptance: Every SEC-14 mutating whitelisted method, including cancel_order, serve_kot, confirm_cancel_kot, qz_print_update, merge_bills, split_bill, table_transfer, create_customer, release_tables_after_print, and kot_execute, is decorated with @frappe.whitelist(methods=["POST"]) or an equivalent POST-only whitelist declaration; non-mutating whitelisted methods remain unchanged; existing callers/tests are updated where needed to use POST; targeted validation confirms these endpoints no longer accept GET.
